text: RESULTS: Complete_Blood_Count: Hemoglobin 8.3 g/dL (low), WBC 81,000 /mm3 (elevated), Platelets 35,600 /mm3 (low); Peripheral_Blood_Smear: Presence of immature cells with large, prominent nucleoli and pink, elongated, needle-shaped cytoplasmic inclusions.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Leukemia. The presence of immature cells with needle-shaped cytoplasmic inclusions (Auer rods) on the smear, combined with pancytopenia (low hemoglobin and platelets) and a significantly elevated white blood cell count, is pathognomonic for acute leukemia.
